header: The pads' plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, played with its tools/gamepad_probe.js as the preload
(--preload): tools/play_plan.json's play with two stand-in pads of one model plugged in at the launcher, before Start
Game, as a player's pads are there when the game starts. Each pad plays a port of its own in the order they were
plugged in (RECOMPINPUT_PADS_IN_ORDER), with no players assigned: the game counts two controllers as it starts them
(gNumOfControllers, 0x800D1FA2, src/pad.c), so the party's setup offers a player for each. Tumble's "How many will
play this time?" comes after more or fewer presses as its messages take their time, so after three of A the plan
presses the stick right (D) then A eight times: right does nothing at a message, makes it 2 players at the question
and moves player 1 to another character at the pick. From there on pad 2 presses A every 300 ms, for player 2's picks
and dice. On the board player 2 is a human's (bit 0 of its stat in GwPlayer, 0x800D1108, 0x38 bytes a player) and
pad 2's A is port 2's alone (D_800CDA7C_main[1], 0x800CDA7E). Its rumble reaches the pads (padRumbles(): plays per
pad, in the order they were plugged in): src/main/main.cpp's Rumble Pak in each port with a controller.
start: plugPads(["Xbox 360 Controller (XInput STANDARD GAMEPAD)","Xbox 360 Controller (XInput STANDARD GAMEPAD)"])
(clearInterval(window.__pad2), window.__pad2 = setInterval(() => { window.__a = !window.__a; padSet(1, window.__a ? { buttons: { 0: 1 } } : undefined); }, 300), 'pad 2 presses A every 300 ms')
play: (clearInterval(window.__pad2), window.__pad2 = setInterval(() => { window.__a = !window.__a; padSet(1, window.__a ? { buttons: { 0: 1 } } : undefined); }, 300), 'pad 2 presses A every 300 ms')
